name: steph-speak-train
description: DRAFT (task I2, docs/mission-finetune.md, private, not published to the Hub yet). Fine-tuning data (SFT and DPO configurations) for steph-speak, a small language model that turns a terminal command's output into a short spoken summary for a blind or visually impaired person. File sha256 below are from the 2026-09-27 pre-R1 validation run of bench/matrix/finetune/build_dataset_release.py, not the final published version.
citeAs: Parra, L. (2026). steph-speak-train: fine-tuning data for spoken summaries of terminal output (draft). https://huggingface.co/datasets/lsmdx/steph-speak-train

distribution.name: dpo-train
distribution.description: Empty in this draft: DPO pairs are built from a trained SFT model's own generations (pref/build_pairs.py), not from raw corpus assembly. Populated at R1.

distribution.name: dpo-validation
distribution.description: Empty in this draft, see dpo-train.

recordSet.name: sft-records
recordSet.description: Supervised fine-tuning pairs: a chat-format conversation and its documentation fields.

field.name: messages
field.description: JSON-encoded chat messages ({role, content}), system/user/assistant (or, for the qa task, two user/assistant turns).

field.name: task
field.description: summary, detail, start, progress, flux, summary_residual or qa.

field.name: source
field.description: Neutral capture category (never a real machine name), e.g. linux-dev, macos.en, snapshot-linux-low, detail, qa-synth.

field.name: provenance
field.description: real_capture (real terminal output) or synthetic_session (synthetic multi-turn arrangement of real captures, qa task only).

field.name: labeler
field.description: Teacher model that wrote the reference answer, always qwen3.5-9b.

field.name: judge
field.description: Invention judge, always qwen3.5-9b-2pass (two-pass consensus, rejects only when both passes agree).

field.name: resynced
field.description: true if the row was re-rendered against the current steph.digest/steph.prompts code from its raw capture; false if kept as already-finalized (no raw capture available, or a task whose format needs no resync).

recordSet.name: dpo-records
recordSet.description: Preference pairs for DPO: a prompt, the grounded chosen answer and a model-generated rejected answer judged inventive. Empty in this draft, see dpo-train's description.

field.name: prompt
field.description: JSON-encoded chat messages (system, user), same shape as sft-records/messages without the assistant turn.

field.name: chosen
field.description: Grounded reference answer (same one the sft configuration would train on for this input).

field.name: rejected
field.description: Answer generated by an already-SFT-trained model, judged inventive by the two-pass judge.

field.name: task
field.description: Always summary in this draft (DPO pairs are only built for the spoken-summary task).

field.name: provenance
field.description: real_capture_chosen_model_generated_rejected: chosen comes from a real capture, rejected from the model under training.

field.name: labeler
field.description: Teacher model behind the chosen answer, always qwen3.5-9b.

field.name: judge
field.description: Invention judge that flagged the rejected answer, always qwen3.5-9b-2pass.

rai:dataCollection: Real captures: terminal command outputs captured on the author's own Linux and macOS machines (French, and English under a forced English locale for the summary task), then anonymized. Synthetic sessions (qa task): multi-turn question/answer sessions composed from the same real captures, arrangement synthetic but content real.
rai:dataCollectionType: Terminal session capture and teacher-model labeling
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Anonymization (user/host/project names, network ranges, MAC/UUID/serials), two independent PII audits (see the dataset card, section Anonymisation, PII), composition matching bench/matrix/finetune/compose_train.py (exact-duplicate and judge-reject removal, per-program cap on supplemental snapshot rows), and, for the summary task where a raw capture is still available, re-rendering against the current bench/matrix/finetune/label.py-based production format with a grounding check against bench/matrix/steph/grounding.py.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Reference answers written by the teacher model Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B (temperature 0, per-task short system prompt), filtered by a two-pass consensus judge of the same model (rejects only when both passes agree on an invention).
rai:dataUseCases: Supervised fine-tuning (sft) and preference fine-tuning (dpo) of the steph-speak small language model.
rai:dataLimitations: French covers every task; English covers only the summary task. Linux and macOS tools only, no Windows. The detail task carries a residual invention rate measured at 26 percent by the judge before filtering. Rows with source starting with snapshot- were not re-verified against the current production code (no raw capture available). The dpo configuration is empty in this draft.
rai:dataBiases: Reflects the author's own machines, shell history and tool choices; command frequency is not a controlled sample of general terminal usage.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: None to our knowledge: anonymized before capture, scanned by two independent automated audits (bench/matrix/finetune/audit_pii.py and audit_pii_second_pass.py), both at zero confirmed findings on this exact release on 2026-09-27 (see the dataset card for sampling detail).
rai:dataSocialImpact: Training data for an accessibility tool (spoken terminal output for blind and visually impaired users).
rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Rebuilt by bench/matrix/finetune/build_dataset_release.py from the finalized rtx3060 corpus, never hand-edited. The version to publish is the one rebuilt after R1 (final retraining); this draft is a pre-R1 validation run.
